items.title: Pack at home, and weigh it twice
items.moves: Everything into the Away, the Talon 44 and the Talon 22. The Sling gets passport, cards, phone and permit wallet and is not opened again until the airport.
items.detail: THE REAL DEADLINE. You fly to LA on the 22nd and the China bags go with you — there is no second chance to repack at home. Weigh the Away at 23 kg for Korean Air and again at 20 kg for the train and the domestic flight; the second number is the one that binds.

items.title: LAX — under the seat against overhead
items.moves: Talon 22 under the seat: prescriptions, daily lenses, glasses, eye drops, blister kit, earplugs, eye mask, toothbrush, a layer. Talon 44 overhead and shut. Away checked to Xi'an.
items.detail: Thirteen hours to Incheon with the overhead bin effectively closed. Anything you might want in the air has to be under the seat before you board — this is the repack the Talon 22 exists for.

items.title: Xi'an — the Away opens
items.moves: Away open on the rack at the Westin for three nights. Talon 22 becomes the day bag for the wall, the warriors and the museum.
items.detail: The only stretch of the trip where everything is unpacked at once. Use it: this is where you find what you forgot, while a shop can still fix it.

items.title: The Xi'an shopping goes in
items.moves: Power bank, slides, wipes, masks, lip balm, eye drops, lozenges, cash and small notes come back from the shops. Power bank into the Talon 44 — carry-on only, never the hold. Slides into the Talon 44 for the train corridor.
items.detail: Six things you deliberately did not fly in. Do it on the 29th or 30th: Golden Week starts on 1 October and the shops stop being pleasant. The power bank must carry a moulded 3C mark or it is taken off you at Lhasa.

items.title: Z165 — the one that matters
items.moves: Thirty hours of kit into the Talon 44: sleepwear, slides, toothbrush, wipes, toilet paper, snacks, power bank, headphones, book. Away shuts and goes under the bunk.
items.detail: THE AWAY DOES NOT OPEN AGAIN UNTIL LHASA. Anything you want in the next thirty hours is in the Talon 44 or the Sling before you board, and the corridor is too narrow to rethink it.

items.title: Lhasa — the rentals arrive
items.moves: Heavy down parka, sleeping bag and trekking poles collected around Barkhor and added to the pile. Away open again at the hotel for three nights.
items.detail: Three items you never carried from Atlanta, which is about 3 kg you did not pay to fly. Handed back on the 10th before the airport transfer.

items.title: Base camp — one bag only
items.moves: Into the Talon 44 for the night: base layers, long johns, heavy socks, warm hat, gloves, headlamp, parka, sleeping bag, liner, hand warmers, body wipes, water, snacks, altitude medication. Everything else stays in Shigatse.
items.detail: ONLY ONE BAG GETS ON THE ECO-BUS. Pack it the night before in Shigatse, not at the transfer, and put the headlamp somewhere you can find it without one — there is no lighting at the toilets.

items.title: Lhasa → Shanghai, and the bed is downtown
items.moves: Rentals returned. Everything back into the Away for the flight; lithium and the power bank stay in the Talon 44. Overnight things stay reachable — you are at the Metropolo for one night before moving again.
items.detail: You land at Hongqiao at 21:50 and go DOWNTOWN, not to Disney. Pack the Saturday night and the Sunday on foot into the top of the bag: you check out at noon on Sunday, leave the bags at the desk, and do not see them again until the evening.
